miapi.module.arsex.cutlass_guard.name: %s Cutlass Guard
miapi.module.arsex.cutlass_guard.descrip: An S-shaped guard, offering protection for your hand.
miapi.module.arsex.cutlass.name: %s Cutlass
miapi.module.arsex.cutlass.description: A curved blade for decently quick strikes.
miapi.module.arsex.shortsword.name: %s Shortsword
miapi.module.arsex.broadsword.name: %s Broadsword
miapi.module.arsex.claymore.name: %s Claymore
miapi.module.arsex.claymore.description: A long, heavy blade, using its mass to its advantage.
miapi.module.arsex.cleaver.name: %s Cleaver
miapi.module.arsex.cleaver.description: A meat cleaver like in everyone's kitchen, ideal for cutting up unarmored targets and tossing it.
miapi.module.arsex.machete.name: %s Machete
miapi.module.arsex.machete.description: A machete, as decent at getting through jungles as decent it is at getting through enemies.
miapi.module.arsex.glaive.name: %s Glaive
miapi.module.arsex.glaive.description: A blade on a polearm, for long-ranged swipes.
miapi.module.arsex.fishing_spear.name: %s Fishing Spear
miapi.module.arsex.fishing_spear.descrip: Not great for combat, the fishing spear provides additional loot on kills.
miapi.module.arsex.lance.name: %s Lance
miapi.module.arsex.lance.description: Best working when mounted, the lance relies on velocity to ditch out damage.
miapi.module.arsex.pike.name: %s Pike
miapi.module.arsex.pike.description: What's better than a long stick? A longer pokey stick!
miapi.module.arsex.halberd.name: %s Halberd
miapi.module.arsex.halberd.description: A versatile polearm, used for both sweeping and thrusting.
miapi.module.arsex.quarterstaff.name: %s Quarterstaff
miapi.module.arsex.quarterstaff.descript: A quick, weak staff to bonk enemies with. Doesn't do much damage, unless the enemy is wearing tough armor.
miapi.module.arsex.greathammer.name: %s Greathammer
miapi.module.arsex.greathammer.descripti: A slow, heavy hammer, best at destroying everything in its path! ...if you find the time to swing it.
miapi.module.arsex.spade.name: %s Spade
miapi.module.arsex.spade.description: A shovel, more suitable for combat than its normal counterpart, though a little worse at digging.
miapi.module.arsex.club.name: %s Club
miapi.module.arsex.club.description: A blunt, simple unga-bunga stick. Just hit your enemies with it.
miapi.module.arsex.heavy_club.name: %s Heavy Club
miapi.module.arsex.heavy_club.descriptio: Just like a club, but bigger and heavier.
miapi.module.arsex.mallet.name: %s Mallet
miapi.module.arsex.mallet.description: Smaller, weaker hammer. Its reduced weight lets you attack faster with it though!
miapi.module.arsex.morning_star.name: %s Morning Star
miapi.module.arsex.morning_star.descript: What's better than a mace? A mace with spikes on it!
miapi.module.arsex.twin_polearm.name: %s Twin Polearm
miapi.module.arsex.twin_polearm.descript: Double the polearm for double the fun! Though...wielding it might be a problem...
miapi.module.arsex.throwing_cross_base.d: The base of a throwing cross. The cross may have some symbolism.
miapi.module.arsex.throwing_cross_top.de: The top part of a throwing cross. The only heads you can put there are from dolls.
The right part of a throwing cross. You could try to nail some animal paws to it.
miapi.module.arsex.throwing_cross_left.d: The left part of a throwing cross. You could try to nail some animal paws to it.
miapi.module.arsex.throwing_cross_bottom: The bottom part of a throwing cross. You could get a bunny's legs nailed to it if you tried.
miapi.module.arsex.throwing_cross.name: %s Throwing Cross
miapi.module.arsex.shuriken_base.name: %s Shuriken Ring
miapi.module.arsex.shuriken_base.descrip: A little ring which forms the base of shurikens and similar throwables.
miapi.module.arsex.shuriken_teeth.name: %s Shuriken
miapi.module.arsex.shuriken_teeth.descri: Shuriken teeth which dig into armor quite well.
miapi.module.arsex.shuriken_saw.name: %s Sawblade
miapi.module.arsex.shuriken_saw.descript: A sawblade which, while not good with armor, is great at giving enemies deep cuts when thrown at them.
